scoring_justification: HWHM and ratio are recomputed from the raw angle‑transmission CSV data, directly verifying the claimed angular tolerance enhancement without trusting agent‑reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference HWHM values and ratio threshold
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 4: SPG HWHM = 9.5 deg, bi‑atomic HWHM = 17 deg, two‑fold enhancement claim
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from paper's reported numbers
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, used to verify that the re‑simulated curves reproduce the angular tolerance enhancement within tolerance, and ratio > 1.5 confirms the claimed improvement.

outputs.description: Angle-resolved transmission curve for the SPG structure. The checker will recompute the half-width at half-maximum (HWHM) of the transmission peak from this data and compare it to the hidden reference.
Angle-resolved transmission curve for the bi-atomic structure. The checker will recompute its HWHM and compute the ratio to the SPG HWHM, verifying the claimed angular tolerance enhancement.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the half-width at half-maximum (HWHM) from the submitted data and assess whether the bi-atomic HWHM is at least 1.5 times the SPG HWHM. Both CSVs must contain at least 15 rows covering 0–30°. The resonance wavelength λ_R is determined by the agent as part of the simulation; the exact value is not prescribed.

steps.note: Half-width at half-maximum computed from SPG angular transmission data; score degrades with absolute deviation.
Half-width at half-maximum for bi-atomic grating, similar scoring.
Ratio of bi-atomic HWHM to SPG HWHM must be at least 1.5 to get full credit; linear ramp from 1.0 to 1.5.
